site_name: 51-56 Manor Road And53-55 Drayton Green RoadWest EalingLondonW13 0LJ
description: Submission of wind microclimate study pursuant to condition 26 & 27 of planning permission ref: 217085FUL dated 17/12/2021 (Appeal Ref: APP/A5270/W/21/3268157) for; Construction of a building with a basement level, part double-height ground floor with part mezzanine floor and 18 and 12 floors above with roof plant and communal roof garden to accommodate two flexible-use units at ground floor (A1/A2/A3/D1 or D2 use classes) and 144 residential units (100% affordable) on the upper floors (mezzanine to 18th floor) with associated cycle and bin stores, substation, private and communal amenity space and alterations to the highway (following demolition of existing buildings on site).
